author: Shadowbladz
body:
Yo, my team be inactive as fuck, so let's go 

Co-lead SMM on OCN, making invatationals (top 16) in both tournaments we played, beating Impact in our second tourney. Joined LunGGlove but was kicked due to inactivity at the time. Now part of Ocean Lads, new EU team that looks very promising.

Mainly a bow player, 90% win rate on Kohi's archer ladder and 80% on Badlion's archer (but Badlion's one sucks ass so who cares amirite)

Not a terrible sword player, can hold my own at tier 2 OCN, once it gets to tier 1 I struggle.

Can cannon pretty well, mainly anti-skybridge/counter-cannoner but I can use spreads/whips

Can shotcall and just communicate well when needed

Youtube
